prompt.en: Which battle at Québec City in 1759 marked the end of France's empire in America?
prompt.fr: Quelle bataille livrée à Québec en 1759 a marqué la fin de l'empire français en Amérique?

options.en: The Battle of the Plains of Abraham.

explanation.en: A British army beat a French one on the Plains of Abraham, above Québec City, in 1759. The other three battles named here come from the War of 1812, half a century later.
explanation.fr: En 1759, une armée britannique a battu une armée française sur les plaines d'Abraham, au-dessus de la ville de Québec. Les trois autres batailles nommées ici viennent de la guerre de 1812, un demi-siècle plus tard.

source.quote: In 1759, the British defeated the French in the Battle of the Plains of Abraham at Québec City

verification.evidence: In the 1700s France and Great Britain battled for control of North America. In 1759, the British defeated the French in the Battle of the Plains of Abraham at Québec City — marking the end of France’s empire in America. … In July, Major-General Sir Isaac Brock captured Detroit but was killed while defending against an American attack at Queenston Heights, near Niagara Falls, a battle the Americans lost. In 1813, Lieutenant-Colonel Charles de Salaberry and 460 soldiers, mostly French Canadiens, turned back 4,000 American invaders at Châteauguay, south of Montreal. … Her bravery contributed to victory at the Battle of Beaver Dams.
